notes: PROVENANCE MISMATCH (headline): the file served as bartender-6's icon (icon.webp, 1024x1024) is the LEGACY photoreal black-tuxedo icon, NOT Bartender 6's current shipping icon. cover.png (icon at left) shows the actual current icon: a Big-Sur/Liquid-Glass squircle with a WHITE, soft-embossed monochrome tuxedo — a full redesign (black->white tonal inversion, photoreal->soft-relief, free-bleed->squircle safe-zone). Do not let this digest represent Bartender 6's real Liquid-Glass icon; ideally re-source that icon and digest it directly. CROP CAVEAT: tightly framed web render — bow tie clipped at the top edge, no squircle margin — consistent with a resized web asset, not the delivered 1024 master. RESOLUTION: clean 1024^2 PNG (from webp); no compression banding, palette sampling reliable. BRAND CONTINUITY finding: the tuxedo signature survives the redesign intact — only tone and rendering changed, so 'formalwear = menu-bar butler' is Bartender's durable icon DNA (icon<->cover palette coherence: both achromatic tuxedos, inverted). ERA-MISMATCH note for synthesis: the 4 failures (1,3,7,10) are the modern (Big-Sur/Liquid-Glass-calibrated) rubric penalising a genuine skeuomorphic icon, not craft defects — the photoreal execution itself is competent (coherent single light, economical palette, physically plausible depth). Single icon — no promotion; feeds era distribution + the skeuomorphic-object cluster seed only.
